explanation: The theorem says that the frame of a square (closed square minus open square) lies in `cover (localGridEdges p s k)`. All of these objects are the library's own definitions: `Plane.closedSquare`, `Plane.openSquare`, `localGridEdges`, `cover`, `localGridX` and `localGridY`. Mathlib has no grid edge cover construction like this. The proof uses only library lemmas (`mem_cover_of_coord_eq` and `mem_cover_of_coord_eq'`) plus `linarith`, so the mathematical content lies in the library's definitions and not in any Mathlib result.
